title: Duplicated AP Note construction in outbox, featured, context
description: src/activitypub.rs:516-547, 610-637, 835-858. Three endpoints (outbox, featured, ap_context_collection) each construct Note JSON with the same fields (id, type, content, attributedTo, to, cc, published, url, context). The logic is identical except that outbox wraps notes in Create activities. A shared build_note_json(post, actor_uri, domain) function would reduce duplication and ensure consistency when adding new fields (e.g. tag, attachment).
